model_output.verdict: A marketing executive whose resume connects leadership, campaigns and launches to business results.
write_up: This is a strong executive marketing resume! From NexGen through Novara, you show the teams and budgets you led alongside changes in leads, revenue and customer acquisition. A recruiter can follow both your progression and what your work accomplished.

The customer advocacy line at Viridian is a good model: it names the program you led and connects it to retention and upsell revenue. Your current role leads with the organization, budget and business you serve, so a recruiter doesn't have to guess how much you oversee.

Your resume isn't likely to be the thing standing between you and a callback. Competition for executive roles still matters. If you've made decisions beyond marketing, adding one could show what you bring to an even broader executive role.
